verdict.rationale: Supabase's first-party Realtime docs list "Postgres Changes: Listen to database changes in real-time," and Broadcast is described as suited to database changes. The GitHub README marks "Realtime subscriptions" as a shipped auto-generated API, and an early community comment praises it for being able to "handle subscription." Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of the client-side subscribe API (filters, event types, SDK usage), documentation of how RLS or authorization applies to change streams, and independent hands-on corroboration of reliability or latency at scale.
